maria-ml: Quick heads-up — on bringup of rerank-v2 (fp16 -> int4 PTQ) I'm seeing a -3.7% NDCG@10 on our 'support-articles' benchmark vs the fp16 baseline. numbers stable across seeds. suspect sampling / provenance mismatch.

ajay: Can you paste the exact eval command and holdout?

maria-ml: Using rnr_eval (sha abc123). Command:
```bash
rnr_eval --model rerank-v2 --baseline rerank-v2-fp16 --quant int4 --holdout holdout_v2.jsonl --slices "ctx_len:<=256,257-1024,>1024" --metric ndcg@10,mrr
```

maria-ml: topline: fp16 ndcg@10 0.512 -> int4 0.493. mrr drops 0.9 pts.

liam: Hmm, are we sure the holdout is the same sampling (user-queries vs passage-queries)? we had an earlier change to doc ingest that moved some queries to shorter docs.

eva: Could also be tokenizer change between tokenizer-v1 and tokenizer-v2 which shifts doc boundaries and pad behavior.

ajay: Let's do quick checks:
- verify holdout provenance (origin field)
- run per-domain slices (support, kb, api-refs)
- run ctx_len buckets

maria-ml: Doing provenance check now, quick grep shows ~12% of holdout rows have origin:"ingest-v2" vs baseline holdout had ingest-v1

maria-ml: starting per-domain slices, kicking off eval in sandbox — will ping with link

deploy-bot: eval run queued: job_id=rnr-2026-03-20-99, ETA ~8m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

metrics-bot: baseline job (rnr-2026-03-20-98) finished. fp16 ndcg@10=0.512, mrr=0.773

maria-ml: int4 slice results (prelim): support ndcg drop 0.02, kb drop 0.04, api-refs +0.01. bigger drops on ctx_len>1024

liam: That pattern points to kv-cache/attention or truncation change. Do we run long-context quant-check? Also check whether quantized op uses sliding window vs full-attn.

ajay: Can you attach one example where score ordering changed? need a minimal repro.

maria-ml: Pasting one example (query + top3 doc ids):
```
query: "how to rotate api keys programmatically"
top3_fp16: [d_120, d_45, d_77]
top3_int4: [d_45, d_120, d_77]
```

maria-ml: Note that d_120 is long (9k chars) and was truncated earlier in ingest-v2.

eva: If ingest-v2 truncates mid-sentence, embedding/contact boundaries change — reranker sensitive to doc prefix.

ajay: Plan: (1) canonicalize holdout to ingest-v1 pipeline for one run (2) run int4 with `--force-context-pad=4096` (3) run int8 dynamic to compare

liam: I'll add a quick unit in eval harness to compare token counts and truncation fingerprint and commit it to branch `eval/holdout-fingerprints`.

maria-ml: Running canonicalized holdout now.

deploy-bot: eval run queued: job_id=rnr-2026-03-20-100

maria-ml: Quick result: canonicalized run int4 ndcg@10 = 0.507 (so reduced loss), mrr = 0.770

ajay: OK that seems to confirm provenance/truncation. good catch.

eva: Next: add a regression test that replays a few 'long doc' cases (store original full text + fingerprint) so ingestion changes will fail CI.

liam: Will open PR with tests + small dataset and add to nightly smoke.

maria-ml: Thanks all. I'll annotate the model ticket with findings and next steps. :thumbsup:

ajay: reassign to eng-ml/eval for follow-up.

maria-ml: Also cc: support-team for potential customer impact.

metrics-bot: summary: root cause likely holdout provenance + truncation; int4 effect amplified on long docs. Follow-ups: fingerprinting, regen holdout, CI test.

eva: :eyes:

maria-ml: closing thread, will update ticket 5342.
